newsitem.title: UK: Yorkshire Electricity exec director retires.
newsitem.headline: Yorkshire Electricity exec director retires.

text.p: Yorkshire Electricity Group Plc said on Friday that Bryan Morgan, a group executive director, had decided "to take early retirement for personal reasons".
The company said in a statement that Morgan, who has been a director since 1992, would resign at a board meeting on November 28.

It did not say if Morgan would be replaced but said Graham Hall, another executive director, would assume responsibility for the electricity and gas supply businesses while Tony Coleman, group finance director, would be responsible for its information technology and telecommunications businesses.
Coleman will report directly to Yorkshire's chief executive Malcolm Chatwin, it said.
